submission.inspiration: We watched family members come home with a one-page exercise sheet after knee surgery and drift within a week because nobody was there to check form or cheer them on. Research puts home physio nonadherence as high as 70 percent, so we wanted something that feels like a supportive clinician in the room, not another gym rep counter.
submission.what_it_does: Restora Coach is a browser-based AI physio for home rehab and senior balance. You pick a short 2 to 3 exercise routine, stand in front of your webcam, and get live safety-aware form feedback with joint-angle targets. After the set, a Gemini coach summarizes your session, updates your streak, and charts progress so patients and older adults stay consistent without installing an app.
submission.how_we_built_it: We used Next.js 14, Tailwind, and shadcn-style UI for a polished single-page flow. MediaPipe Pose Landmarker tracks 33 landmarks client-side with EMA smoothing and rep state machines per exercise. Gemini 2.5 Flash generates post-session coaching when judges add a free API key in Settings; otherwise we ship warm fallback copy. Streaks and history live in localStorage with seeded demo data on first load.
submission.challenges: Landmark jitter required jump rejection and angle debouncing so reps do not double-count. We also had to cache fallback coach text so a 429 from Gemini never blocks the demo finish screen.
submission.accomplishments: A full safety-first rehab angle with voice cues, adaptive difficulty levels, Docker deployment, and a 60-second judge path from goal pick to streak update.
submission.what_we_learned: Keeping routines to three movements and pairing positive feedback with visible streaks matches adherence research better than feature-heavy fitness apps.
submission.whats_next: Clinician dashboard to prescribe custom ROM targets, optional encrypted cloud sync, more exercises validated with PT advisors, offline PWA install, and multilingual voice packs.
submission.category_hint: ML/AI + Social Good (Health and Fitness Technology)
